Le Meurice keeps reinventing itself room by room. The Dorchester Collection palace on rue de Rivoli has unveiled 15 newly renovated rooms and suites on its sixth floor, as reported by Robb Report on 17 October 2026. It is the latest phase of a refurbishment programme led by the architecture duo Lally & Berger.

## Craft at every level

The new rooms bring together some of the best names in French and European craftsmanship: hand-painted de Gournay wallpapers, mirror and glasswork by Ateliers Pictet and Baccarat crystal wall sconces. One suite features a diorama of Virginia Oldoini, Countess of Castiglione. Rates have not been published.

Margaux Lally and Luc Berger have been shaping the palace's rooms for several years. They renovated 29 rooms and suites in 2020, with the 620 m² Belle Étoile penthouse at the top of the building, and 20 more in 2021.

## A new general manager at the helm

The project unfolds under Pascal Billard, general manager of Le Meurice since 1 August 2025. He succeeded Franka Holtmann, who led the hotel for more than 18 years. Billard knows Dorchester Collection well: he was resident manager of Hôtel Plaza Athénée from 2009 to 2013, before running the Majestic Hotel & Spa in Barcelona for twelve years. He has more than 35 years in hospitality. Christopher Cowdray, then president of Dorchester Collection, welcomed his return to the group.

Le Meurice also holds the restaurant Le Meurice Alain Ducasse and Cédric Grolet's pastry at Le Dalí.

## The signal

In Paris, palaces now renovate floor by floor rather than closing their doors. Each phase becomes a reason to talk about the house again, and a stage for the craftspeople who make French luxury.

Congratulations to Pascal Billard and the Le Meurice teams.
summary: Le Meurice has unveiled 15 renovated rooms and suites on its sixth floor by Lally & Berger, under general manager Pascal Billard.
title: Le Meurice unveils 15 new rooms and suites under Pascal Billard
why: A Paris palace renews its rooms floor by floor with France's finest crafts.
